evidence: Keyboard test showed unclear focus highlighting
user_impact: Keyboard users may struggle to identify the focused element
recommended_fix: Provide a clearly visible focus indicator with sufficient contrast

evidence: Lighthouse reported buttons without accessible names
user_impact: Screen reader users may not understand the purpose of affected buttons
recommended_fix: Give affected buttons meaningful accessible names

evidence: Lighthouse reported tabindex values greater than zero
user_impact: Keyboard navigation may follow an unexpected order
recommended_fix: Use natural document order and appropriate tabindex values

user_impact: Screen reader users may find the page structure harder to understand
recommended_fix: Organize headings in a logical hierarchy

evidence: Lighthouse reported touch targets with insufficient size or spacing
user_impact: Users with motor difficulties may struggle to activate small or closely spaced controls
recommended_fix: Provide sufficiently large and appropriately spaced interactive targets
